figurative_meaning_en: A source of endless happiness or prosperity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চাকরিটি তার জীবনের সোনার হাঁস।
এই ব্যবসা আমাদের পরিবারের সোনার হাঁস হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His job is the golden goose of his life.
This business has become the golden goose for our family.
history: Derived from European folklore like the Grimm Brothers' 'The Golden Goose' fairy tale, adapted into Bengali proverbs to symbolize enduring wealth.
note: Often used to describe a reliable source of income or joy without implying exploitation.
